assertions.text: Installed Codex0.154.0 emits plan-specific subscription-limit templates from loopback usage_limit_reached responses. Native Plus/Pro runs suspend their owning slot through the real supervisor and API.
Classify known terminal templates as quota while preserving unknown failures, explicit recovery and cleanup. Do not derive retry instants from localized display text.

alternatives.option: Recognize observed terminal templates in the existing bounded stream parser
Match arbitrary stderr or tool text for quota keywords

verification_criteria: Regression fails before change and package race tests pass after
Installed Codex loopback Plus/Pro fixtures retain session association, failure and slot suspension
Full unit suite and static checks pass
reopening_conditions: Native diagnostic templates or event envelopes change
A verified Agy quota discriminator becomes available
residual_risk: Known diagnostic templates are a bounded native observation, not universal future wording coverage.
No current provider capacity, real account exhaustion or full-v1 acceptance claim.
No new store/schema contract; earlier database and restore tests remain evidence for unchanged durable failure storage.
